lead: Great custom software doesn't add steps.
punch: It removes the ones nobody wanted to do.
question: Which manual step slows your team down most?
instagram_caption:
Daily Tech Talk #29 💡

Great custom software doesn't add steps. It removes the ones nobody wanted to do.

Every system we build starts with one simple question: what is your team doing by hand every day that they wish they could skip?

Copying data between tools, chasing updates, and formatting the same reports every week are signs that your software is working against you. Good systems get out of the way.

Which manual step slows your team down most? Tell us in the comments 👇

linkedin_post:
"We need a new tool to manage our process."

Usually, what teams actually need is fewer tools, connected better.

When software is built around how your business actually runs, it shouldn't introduce extra screens, data entry, or approval gates. Its entire job is to eliminate the tedious steps that eat up your afternoon.

Before adding another subscription to your stack, look at where your team spends time copying data from one window into another. That friction is where custom workflow design pays off.
